title: [DEV] Enhancement: Time underneath carb icon
body:
The time stamp underneath the carb icon on home screen leads to an additional line which wastes space on small phones like Jelly 2 (see screenshot). Maybe there’s an option to have it optional or remove it?
Thanks for considering.
![27BB6A55-A033-4B9A-B64C-08D75EDD45EA](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13958493/161439150-1d0954d8-5ac7-42fc-9bbe-11d1a4d21c65.jpeg)
